'''041339''' was an accident report regarding an incident on Level 15, Sector G, in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Twenty [[Q-4 Borer Droid]]s malfunctioned, causing structural instability in several [[Mining/Legends|mining]] tunnels; tunnels C and D collapsed due to vibrations caused by tunnelling equipment. Four workers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] and three injured [[M-04-12|during]] the accident, and financial losses were [[D-04-05|estimated]] at over 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Operations on level 15 were suspended until sector G could be sealed off. [[S-04-12|Reports]] from [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] to security stated that the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] acted in a coordinate pattern that suggested they had been tampered with.
